text:
lina (support): Hey team, customer acme-prod reporting p50/p95 latency spikes on /v1/streams during bursts. Need repro info to build a throughput repro pack. Can someone confirm which bits to ask for? :wave:

ben (oncall): Please collect the following: 1) exact request timestamps and x-request-id header(s), 2) a sample curl that reproduces (with auth redacted), 3) concurrency profile (clients/threads and RPS), 4) promptset and typical token counts (prompt + completion). Prefer a debug bundle from the customer's side if possible.

lina (support): Got it — customer can provide logs but they want guidance for safe redaction. What fields to redact?

maria (cs): Tell them to redact Authorization tokens and any PII in prompts. Keep x-request-id and timestamps intact. They should replace tokens with <REDACTED_AUTH>.

sree (ml-eng): Also ask for model name + version, quantization flags, and whether they use streaming or non-streaming. Tokenization differences matter.

ben (oncall): Add a small cURL template they can paste (replace API_URL/AUTH):

ben (oncall): ```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_AUTH>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b", "input":[{"role":"user","content":"<sample prompt>"}], "max_tokens":128}'
```

lina (support): Customer sent 3 request IDs (x-req: abc123, def456, ghi789) and a small cURL — attaching below.

infra-bot: debug bundle created: https://internal.redwood/debug-bundles/1784302100-abc (expires in 7 days). Logs include backend traces and per-token timings.

sree (ml-eng): Run the cURL with a concurrency sweep: threads=1,4,8,16 and token lengths: short(<=64), mid(200-400), long(>800). Record p50/p95/p99 and throughput (tps). Also capture client-side CPU/mem and any dropped connections.

maria (cs): Customer asked whether they should include billing info — not needed for repro, but include account id and approximate usage window for org-level context.

lina (support): Customer says spikes occur only during burst window between 15:32-15:40 UTC yesterday; attached their curl and timestamps. I'll upload their debug bundle link.

ben (oncall): Quick checklist to include in thread for customer:
- request ids (header names)
- full raw request/response (headers + bodies) with auth redacted
- client concurrency profile and RPS numbers
- promptset (sample 10 prompts covering token distributions)
- model name/version and streaming vs non-streaming
- a small script or k6/hey/ab load snippet if they can run

sree (ml-eng): If we can't reproduce, ask them to run our small repro harness and paste results. Provide sample k6 script: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({model:'redwood-13b', input:[{role:'user',content:'hello'}]});
  const params = {headers: {'Authorization':'Bearer <REDACTED_AUTH>','Content-Type':'application/json'}};
  let r = http.post('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate', payload, params);
  check(r, {'status 200': (r) => r.status==200});
}
```

lina (support): Thanks — I'll send the checklist and ask for the 10-prompt set + concurrency matrix. Will update when bundle arrives. :thumbsup:

maria (cs): FYI flagged as high-touch; I'll offer to help run the harness with them in a screen share.

ben (oncall): Noted. Assigning to eng-ml for deeper traces if repro confirmed.

lastmsg (system): thread closed by lina (support) after customer uploaded missing logs (1784302175).
